newsitem.title: USA: Great Western sets June 13 mtg date.
newsitem.headline: Great Western sets June 13 mtg date.

text.p: Great Western Financial Corp said Friday that its board of directors has set June 13 as the date for its 1997 annual meeting, with a record date of May 9.

On April 9, H.F. Ahmanson & Co said that it submitted consents of a sufficient number of Great Western shares on proposals, including an amendment to Great Western's by-laws, requiring the annual meeting to be held on the fourth Tuesday in April or within fourteen days of then, which this year would be May 6.
The company said that at the meeting, stockholders will elect four Class II directors and consider one advisory resolution and five separate proposed by-law amendments submitted by Ahmanson.

Great Western said it has been soliciting consent revocations and is unable at this time to determine whether Ahmanson has received sufficient unrevoked consents in support of any of its proposals, including its proposal regarding the annual meeting.
Great Western said that the annual meeting cannot "reasonably" be held on May 6, only 25 days from now.

According to the company, under the federal proxy rules, the earliest record date that can be set to determine which stockholders are entitled to receive proxy materials and vote at the annual meeting is May 9, which is the record date set by Great Western's board.
If the earliest record date permissible is May 9, the meeting date "obviously cannot occur on May 6," Great Wetsern said.
